description: A single-panel waterfall/stacked-contribution bar chart quantifying the yield-strength (YS) contributions of a duplex lightweight steel. The y-axis is labelled "Strength contribution (MPa)" with major gridline ticks at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200 and 1400 MPa; there is no x-axis category axis, only the mechanism labels written above each bar element. The leftmost element is a tall red-gradient bar labelled σ_HDI with the printed value 597. To its right, seven floating, colour-graded boxes step upwards, each carrying the mechanism symbol and its printed value in MPa: σ_0,γ f_γ = 78 (orange), σ_ss,γ f_γ = 182 (yellow), σ_dis,γ f_γ = 85 (green), σ_VC f_γ = 74 (blue), σ_LRO f_γ = 119 (blue-violet), σ_0,B2 f_B2 = 135 (violet), and σ_dis,B2 f_B2 = 46 (grey-violet). The rightmost element is a tall stacked bar built from coloured segments matching the individual contributions in the same order, labelled "Exp. σ_YS" whose top lies just above the 1300 MPa level, i.e. the cumulative sum of all eight printed contributions (597+78+182+85+74+119+135+46 = 1316 MPa). The figure demonstrates that HDI stress dominates the strength of this duplex lightweight steel, with solution strengthening and the two nanoparticle-related terms (LRO and VC) providing the next largest increments.

observations.observation: The y-axis is labelled 'Strength contribution (MPa)' and is scaled from 0 to 1400 MPa in 200 MPa increments.
The HDI-stress contribution bar is labelled σ_HDI and prints the value 597 MPa, the largest single contribution shown.
The solution-strengthening term for austenite, σ_ss,γ f_γ, prints 182 MPa and is the second-largest printed contribution.
The LRO-related term σ_LRO f_γ prints 119 MPa and the B2-phase term σ_0,B2 f_B2 prints 135 MPa.
The VC-carbide term σ_VC f_γ prints 74 MPa, σ_dis,γ f_γ prints 85 MPa, σ_0,γ f_γ prints 78 MPa, and σ_dis,B2 f_B2 prints 46 MPa.
The cumulative sum of the eight printed contributions (597+78+182+85+74+119+135+46) equals 1316 MPa, matching the height of the rightmost stacked bar.
The rightmost stacked bar is labelled 'Exp. σ_YS' and is built from colour-coded segments corresponding to each individual strengthening contribution.
No x-axis category labels are printed; the mechanisms are identified only by the σ symbols written above each bar element.
The caption states that the figure shows the calculated YS of the duplex lightweight steel.

The rightmost bar is labelled 'Exp. σ_YS' (experimental yield strength), which differs from the caption wording 'calculated YS'; the figure itself does not state whether the total is calculated or measured.

The citing text states that HDI stress, solution strengthening and precipitation strengthening from nanoscale LRO and VC particles are the primary strengthening mechanisms, consistent with the bar magnitudes shown.

subfigures.description: Red-gradient vertical bar labelled σ_HDI with a printed value of 597 MPa, reaching just below the 600 MPa gridline; it is the tallest single contribution in the figure.

Seven floating waterfall-step boxes rising left to right, each labelled with a mechanism symbol and a printed MPa value: σ_0,γ f_γ = 78, σ_ss,γ f_γ = 182, σ_dis,γ f_γ = 85, σ_VC f_γ = 74, σ_LRO f_γ = 119, σ_0,B2 f_B2 = 135, σ_dis,B2 f_B2 = 46.

Tall stacked bar labelled 'Exp. σ_YS' composed of coloured segments matching each individual contribution, its top near the 1316 MPa cumulative level (just above the 1300 MPa position between the 1200 and 1400 MPa gridlines).
